description: Proposed bounded RTX 3090 pilot; not benchmarked on a 3090. Fresh task contract with a 10 s timeout. No smoke checkpoint resume.

review_gates.world_model: Audit held-out Newton starts at 1/4/8 steps with recorded actions; inspect phase-dependent height/orientation bias and paired reward errors before increasing horizon or noise.
review_gates.standing: Require all 3 evaluation seeds to reach normal timeout at 2, 5 and 10 s, with stable height/tilt, before calling the task converged.
review_gates.scope: One seed per launch. Calibration stops at iteration 200 with no Actor updates; review paired WM diagnostics before explicitly resuming a pilot to total iteration 600. Each launch also stops after 30 min. No automatic extension.
